role: campaign adapter for scripts.launch_native_metadata_ranges_cold_spot.main(attempt, campaign=module); same shape as launch_native_workspace_execution_spot (bootstrap = launch_native_semantic_router_cold_spot.user_data patched, startup.poll, ACK/terminate+wait+collect in shared.main)
cli: launch_cohere_native_preflight_spot.py aNNNN        (controller: shared.main; refuses until config READY)
--stage REPO OUT                                     (instance: write source-qualification.json/config copies; re-run preflight checks on the archived source)
--transport ROOT                                     (instance: fetch 2 shards + 5 binaries, stream SHA/exact length, no decoding)
--check-closed ROOT                                  (instance: authenticate the helper terminal/inventory and map exit status)
--replay OUT                                         (offline: authenticate collected artifacts vs the helper terminal inventory)

campaign_attributes.INSTANCE_TYPE/IMAGE/SUBNET: reuse launch_native_workspace_execution_spot values (c7i.2xlarge x86_64 Ubuntu 24.04); SPOT_MAX_USD_PER_HOUR .50, COMPUTE_CAP 1.50, ebs_s3_allowance .15 (shared main)
campaign_attributes.instance_root: /mnt/borsuk-cohere (root template layout: repo/, input/en/<shard>, bin/<role>, preflight/, transport-receipt.json, retention-receipt.json)

root_supplied_config.format: JSON at CONFIG; exact key set, no defaults

keys.controller_authority_pending: must be false else REFUSE launch (no pending shortcut for gates; admission is separately READY-checked)
keys.controller_source_commit: 40-hex frozen controller commit (config commit immediately follows it, as the workspace seam)
keys.controller_code_sha256: {every CODE path: sha256}; CODE = shared bootstrap chain + this launcher + scripts/run_cohere_native_preflight.py and its imported helpers
keys.source_identity_sha256: current full412 native source identity; must equal the helper config and the admission receipt
keys.helper_config: {path (repo-relative), bytes, sha256}: the frozen run_cohere_native_preflight CONFIG whose paths are absolute under /mnt/cohere-native-preflight; the launcher passes its SHA verbatim
keys.transports: {shards: {publisher_path -> locator}, binaries: {role -> s3 key}}: locators only. bytes/SHA come from the helper config pins (shards pinned to 216612385/216746705; five roles)
keys.source_archive_paths / source_archive_pa: existing minimal-archive roster; must contain the helper, CODE, helper_config, admission receipt and gate receipt files
keys.resources: fixed echo of the root proposal: helper_deadline 9600, machine 10800, compute 1.50, ancillary .15, build CPU4/8GiB, query CPU1/512MiB, swap 0, scratch 8GiB (launcher refuses any other value)

launch_refusals_before_any_AWS_call: dirty tree / controller or code hash drift
source identity mismatch (config vs helper config vs admission)
admission receipt status != READY_NATIVE_PREFLIGHT, gate not all-zero/terminated, gate/role source identity mismatch, role bytes/SHA != helper config binary pin, basename != local_basename
helper config resources/limits outside the proposal maxima or paths outside /mnt/cohere-native-preflight

shard locator not exactly https://huggingface.co/datasets/CohereLabs/wikipedia-2023-11-embed-multilingual-v3/resolve/ade45fb52bd549f5e8c065636fe4160a43c2af36/<publisher_path> (or the root's s3:// staging key in the bucket), wrong publisher_path order/length, binary key outside research/
archive roster missing a required file or not committed regular files (shared source_archive check)
instance_phases: install: python3.12 -c 'import boto3' (shared bootstrap; no Rust toolchain, no Cargo)
source-qualification: --stage re-validates the archived source and writes source-qualification.json

transport: --transport; urllib/boto3 streaming, per body exact length cap + SHA256 before atomic rename; redirects to other hosts refused; destinations must not exist; failure removes the partial file; writes transport-receipt.json; binaries chmod 0500; never decodes bytes

preflight: systemctl start borsuk-global-leaf-<attempt>.slice; set-property --runtime MemoryMax=8448M MemorySwapMax=0 CPUQuota=400% TasksMax=512; systemd-run --slice=... --setenv=BORSUK_GLOBAL_LEAF_SLICE=<slice> RuntimeMaxSec=9660 python3.12 scripts/run_cohere_native_preflight.py HELPER_CONFIG HELPER_CONFIG_SHA $root/preflight (delegated-supervisor pattern of launch_hierarchical_cells_100k_spot); /usr/bin/time -v resource file; helper exit code preserved

check-closed: --check-closed authenticates preflight/terminal.json inventory against every retained file and maps status NATIVE_CHAIN_CLOSED(exit0)/BASELINE_NONZERO_EXIT(2)/INVALID(2); bootstrap exits with the helper's code after collection
slice cleanup: systemctl stop <slice> in the existing EXIT trap before collection

collection.artifacts: small evidence only: source-qualification.json, config copies, transport-receipt.json, cpu.txt, helper log/resources, preflight/{config,admission,execution-receipt,terminal,publish-receipt}.json, prepared/complete.json, generation manifests, 7x(<stage>.log, -closure, -stage, -stage-receipt, -unit.log, configs/<stage>.json), baseline-result.jsonl (opaque per-query bytes), run-closed.log. Corpus/queries/truth/normalized/order/SQ8/store stay on the instance and are pinned by sha256 in the helper terminal inventory only.
collection.replay: offline: every collected preflight/* file must equal the helper terminal.inventory entry; terminal.status/exit code/complete consistent; reservation qualification == proof; no quality is interpreted
collection.terminate: shared.main: terminate_owned + waiter BEFORE collection; ACK/launch receipts fsynced; same instance IDs asserted in terminal/closeout

synthetic_tests: preflight refusals: pending flag, hash/identity drift, admission PENDING/FAILED/nonzero gate/role SHA mismatch, wrong/short shard length, bad locator host/revision/path, resource widening, roster gaps
transport on fake sources: success; wrong SHA; short; overlong; redirect/other host; occupied destination; partial removed; binaries mode
fake helper closure: NATIVE_CHAIN_CLOSED exit0, BASELINE_NONZERO_EXIT, INVALID, truncated/tampered inventory, extra file
real shared.main lifecycle with mocked boto3/EC2: success, multi-ACK same IDs, fsync fail, upload fail, SIGTERM/interrupt, waiter failure: terminate+wait strictly before collect
bootstrap: bash -n, <16KiB user data, exact helper argv/slice/resource flags, terminal script run on synthetic artifacts
limits CPU1/256MiB/noSwap/120s; no native, Cargo, network, AWS, corpus
remaining_root_pins_before_freeze: helper config body+sha (absolute instance paths) after original 80402 closes 0
completed READY_NATIVE_PREFLIGHT admission receipt + gate receipt pointers
shard locators (HF pinned or root-staged s3) and 5 binary S3 keys; full SHA/length are already helper-config pins
controller commit, native source manifest identity, archive roster and code hashes, cost quote
paid launch authority (this adapter never launches by itself)
never: edits to shared modules, Rust, run_cohere_native_preflight.py, or original 80402

implementation.qualify: portable (no Git/AWS): exact config keys, controller_authority_pending is False, exact CODE roster+hashes (CODE == exact transitive import closure, asserted in the self-check), full native source identity, helper config pin (identity, deadlines<=proposal maxima, instance paths, shard lengths), READY admission via helper.admit on a locally path-mapped copy, locator allow-list, sorted archive roster + hash/count + required-file closure + support SHA map
implementation.preflight: qualify + clean tree, one source-bundle parent, config-only commit after controller, origin ref, committed support blobs
implementation.locators: shards: exactly https://huggingface.co/datasets/CohereLabs/wikipedia-2023-11-embed-multilingual-v3/resolve/ade45fb52bd549f5e8c065636fe4160a43c2af36/<publisher_path> or s3://<bucket>/research/...; binaries: research/... keys, distinct; curl uses --proto =https --proto-redir =https --max-redirs 5 --max-filesize <exact bytes>; aws s3 cp for s3

instance_cli.--stage: qualify archived source, env-bound roster, write source-qualification.json/config.json/helper-config.json
instance_cli.--transport: fetch to .part, exact length + streaming SHA256, atomic rename, binaries 0500, transport-receipt.json; stops at the first bad body; destinations/.part must not exist
instance_cli.--check-closed ROOT EXIT: helper terminal-last inventory re-hashed; exit/status/complete mapping (NATIVE_CHAIN_CLOSED 0, BASELINE_NONZERO_EXIT 2 complete, INVALID 2 incomplete)

implementation.exit: bootstrap exits with the helper exit code after collection (nonzero helper code => terminal failed, evidence still collected and replayable)

source_only_check_receipt.result: PASS rc=0; ~2.5s wall, ~73MB rss; py_compile OK (after HEAD/userinfo/port repair)
source_only_check_receipt.new_checks: redirect policy (allowed CDN hop; refusal before any body for other host/http/suffix/userinfo/file/loop/403/duplicate Location; --max-redirs 0 final GET), root redirect_hosts validation (wildcard/initial host/unsorted/scheme/missing), retention (bounded sequential uploads, head-object size, metadata sha, first-failure stop without receipt, exclusive receipt, bootstrap ordering transport<helper<check-closed<retain), collect head_object verification and tampered receipt/inventory/size/sha rejection
source_only_check_receipt.mocked: EC2/S3/boto3, curl/aws, systemd, native programs; no AWS/network/Cargo/Rust/corpus
source_only_check_receipt.redirect_repair: probe command asserted --head with no -r/--range/-o; refusals for other host, http, suffix, userinfo (user:pass, user-only, empty userinfo, @ host trick), ports 8443/0/non-numeric, file, loop, 403, duplicate Location all assert calls == [probe(first)] (offending hop never probed/fetched); explicit :443 accepted

transport_policy.redirects: HTTPS only, at most 5 hops; every hop is probed with a body-free `curl --head` (no Range/GET/-o probe) and must have scheme https, hostname exactly huggingface.co or a root-specified entry of config.transports.redirect_hosts (<=4, sorted, no wildcards), NO userinfo (no @ in netloc, username/password None) and port None or 443; invalid/zero/other ports refused; the offending hop is never probed or fetched; final status must be 200; final GET uses --max-redirs 0 --max-filesize <exact bytes>; exact length and SHA256 remain the final authority
transport_policy.root_checks: HEAD metadata only; the root supplies the exact CDN host list in config.transports.redirect_hosts
transport_policy.allowlist_authorized_by_root: huggingface.co + us.aws.cdn.hf.co (body-free HEAD verified by the root for both shards)

retention.when: after --check-closed validates the helper terminal-last inventory and before the bootstrap exit/trap; runs for NATIVE_CHAIN_CLOSED, BASELINE_NONZERO_EXIT and INVALID-with-terminal; retention failure => exit 96
retention.what: inventory entries under prepared/ (corpus.f32, queries.f32, truth.u64, corpus/queries IDs, complete.json), normalized.f32, order.u64, sq8.bin, generation/**, store/** (final-key SQ8 + head) that are not already small collected artifacts; scratch/** and baseline scratch excluded
retention.how: aws s3 cp streaming per object to s3://<bucket>/<prefix>/retained/<relative path> with --metadata sha256=<helper inventory SHA>; then s3api head-object ContentLength must equal the inventory bytes; no Python decoding; no extra local scratch (reads existing files)
retention.bounds: <=1GiB per object, <=4GiB total; receipt retention-receipt.json (key, path, bytes, sha256 per object) is an authenticated collected artifact pinned in the terminal; never overwritten
retention.collection_replay: collect() head_object-verifies ContentLength and sha256 metadata of every retained object; replay requires the full retained set for a closed run and equality with the helper inventory
retention.reuse: retained queries.f32/truth.u64/IDs + normalized/order/SQ8/generation/store allow an S3 Vectors comparison on the identical corpus/queries without rerunning cohort/GT/index

s3_cost_estimate_usd.retained_bytes_approx: ~1.04GB known (corpus 409.6MB + normalized 409.6MB + SQ8 103.6MB + store SQ8 103.6MB + queries 4.1MB + order .8MB + truth .08MB) + generation (unmeasured, capped by the 4GiB total)
s3_cost_estimate_usd.verdict: fits the $0.15 ancillary allowance; monthly retention storage continues until the root deletes the prefix

scratch: retention reads files in place; the 8GiB helper scratch cap is unchanged
root_template_alignment: layout adapted to /tmp/borsuk-cohere-native-preflight-pending-config.json (input/en/<shard>, bin/<role>); the template remains PENDING_NOT_EXECUTABLE
